title: Dryer Repair
metaTitle: Dryer Repair Service | Gas & Electric | Blue Jay Appliance
metaDescription: Expert dryer repair — not heating, noisy, won't spin, takes too long. Gas and electric. Same or next-day service, 90-day warranty. Call (630) 998-0209.
heroSubheading: Dryer not heating, taking too long, or making strange noises? We repair all dryer types including gas and electric models. Fast turnaround so your laundry routine stays on track.

contentSections.heading: Gas & Electric Dryer Repair Experts
contentSections.body: A dryer that won't heat or takes multiple cycles wastes energy and time. Blue Jay Appliance Services repairs both gas and electric dryers from every major brand — Whirlpool, Maytag, Samsung, LG, GE, Speed Queen, and more. Our gas-certified technicians handle igniter replacements, thermal fuse failures, and gas valve issues safely. For electric models, we diagnose heating elements, thermostats, and motor problems. We also check your dryer vent on every service call because restricted airflow is the leading cause of dryer performance issues and a serious fire hazard.

contentSections.heading: Why Homeowners Trust Blue Jay for Dryer Repair
contentSections.body: Dryer problems are rarely as simple as they seem online. A 'not heating' symptom could be the element, the thermal fuse, or a vent restriction — and the wrong diagnosis wastes your money. Our technicians test systematically, explain what they find, and give you a written estimate before starting work. Every repair carries our 90-day parts and labor warranty, and most are completed on the first visit.

heroSubheading: Washer won't spin, drain, or start? From top-loaders to front-load HE machines, our techs fix it fast. We service all major brands with a 90-day parts and labor warranty.

contentSections.heading: Washing Machine Repair for Every Brand & Configuration
contentSections.body: Whether you have a traditional top-loader, a high-efficiency front-load washer, or a compact stackable unit, Blue Jay Appliance Services diagnoses and repairs them all. Common washer failures include drain pump clogs, worn tub bearings, lid switch and door latch problems, faulty water inlet valves, and control board malfunctions. Our technicians arrive with diagnostic tools and common parts for Whirlpool, Samsung, LG, GE, Maytag, Speed Queen, and every other major brand.

contentSections.heading: Honest Diagnosis, Fair Pricing, Lasting Repairs
contentSections.body: Washer repairs can range from a simple pump clearing to a complex bearing replacement — and the right call depends on your machine's age, condition, and the specific failure. We never push unnecessary repairs. Our technicians diagnose the real problem, present a written estimate, and let you decide. If your washer isn't worth fixing, we'll say so. Every repair is backed by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

metaTitle: Refrigerator & Freezer Repair | Same-Day Cooling Fix | Blue Jay Appliance
metaDescription: Expert refrigerator & freezer repair — not cooling, ice maker broken, leaking. All brands including Sub-Zero. Same-day priority. Call (630) 998-0209.
heroSubheading: Fridge not cooling, freezer icing up, or water leaking on the floor? We troubleshoot and repair all refrigerator and freezer types — including French door, side-by-side, and built-in models.

contentSections.heading: Fast Refrigerator & Freezer Repair — Cooling Emergencies Welcome
contentSections.body: A refrigerator that stops cooling puts hundreds of dollars in food at risk. Blue Jay Appliance Services treats cooling failures as same-day priorities. We repair every configuration — top-freezer, bottom-freezer, side-by-side, French door, and built-in units from Sub-Zero, Viking, Thermador, and all mainstream brands. Our technicians diagnose compressor issues, evaporator fan failures, defrost system problems, thermostat malfunctions, and sealed system leaks with precision tools that distinguish between a $40 relay and a $600 compressor.

contentSections.heading: Protecting Your Investment with Accurate Diagnosis
contentSections.body: Refrigerator repair requires careful diagnosis because the symptoms often mislead. A fridge that runs constantly might have dirty condenser coils — a 15-minute fix — or a failing compressor that costs more than the unit is worth. We test methodically, explain our findings, and give you a written estimate so you can make an informed decision. No pressure, no unnecessary parts, and a 90-day warranty on every repair we perform.

metaTitle: Range & Oven Repair | Gas & Electric | Blue Jay Appliance

heroSubheading: Burners won't ignite, oven not reaching temperature, or uneven heating? Our technicians repair gas and electric ranges and ovens from all major manufacturers.

contentSections.heading: Gas-Certified Range & Oven Repair
contentSections.body: Range and oven problems range from a weak gas igniter to a failed control board — and gas issues in particular require certified technicians who understand safety protocols. Blue Jay Appliance Services is fully gas-certified for all range and oven work. We repair igniters, thermostats, bake and broil elements, gas valves, door hinges, self-clean locks, and electronic controls on GE, Whirlpool, Samsung, LG, KitchenAid, Wolf, Viking, Thermador, and every other brand.

contentSections.heading: Safety-First Approach to Every Range & Oven Call
contentSections.body: Gas leaks and ignition problems aren't something to troubleshoot from a YouTube video. Our technicians verify gas connections, test for leaks, and ensure safe operation after every repair. For electric models, we test element continuity, wiring integrity, and control board function before clearing the unit for use. Written estimates before work begins, 90-day warranty on all repairs, and honest advice on whether repair or replacement makes sense for your situation.

heroSubheading: Cooktop not working properly? Whether it's a gas igniter issue, faulty burner element, or broken control, we get your cooktop back to full performance quickly.

contentSections.heading: Complete Cooktop Repair — Every Fuel Type, Every Brand
contentSections.body: Blue Jay Appliance Services repairs gas, electric, and induction cooktops in every configuration — freestanding, drop-in, and built-in. From high-BTU pro-style gas cooktops by Wolf and Thermador to everyday ceramic and induction models from GE and Whirlpool, our technicians carry diagnostic tools and parts for efficient same-visit repair. We handle igniter replacements, element swaps, control board repairs, and glass surface issues.

contentSections.heading: Precision Diagnosis for Every Cooktop Type
contentSections.body: Cooktop problems can be deceptive — a burner that won't light might be an igniter, a gas valve, or a spark module issue. Electric and induction cooktops have their own failure patterns including element burnout, cracked glass, and control board malfunctions. We test each component individually, give you a clear written estimate, and complete the repair with a 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

metaTitle: Garbage Disposal Repair & Installation | Blue Jay Appliance

heroSubheading: Garbage disposal jammed, humming, or leaking? We repair and install all major disposal brands. Need a new unit? We handle full replacement and installation too.

contentSections.heading: Disposal Repair & Replacement in One Visit
contentSections.body: A broken garbage disposal brings your kitchen sink to a halt. Blue Jay Appliance Services handles everything from clearing stubborn jams and fixing leaks to complete unit replacement with upgraded models. We repair InSinkErator, Waste King, GE, KitchenAid, Moen, and all other brands. For replacements, we carry InSinkErator and Waste King units for same-day installation — including all plumbing connections, electrical work, and dishwasher drain hookups.

contentSections.heading: Repair vs. Replace — We Help You Decide
contentSections.body: Garbage disposals typically last 10-12 years. If yours is younger and has a simple jam or a tripped reset, repair is quick and affordable. If the motor hums without grinding, the unit leaks from the bottom, or it's over a decade old, replacement is usually the smarter investment. We assess honestly, show you the options, and let you choose. New installations include proper mounting, electrical wiring, plumbing connections, and a 90-day warranty.

heroSubheading: Need a new water heater? We install gas and electric tank water heaters with proper permitting, code-compliant connections, and old unit removal included.

contentSections.heading: Professional Water Heater Installation Done Right
contentSections.body: Whether you're replacing a failing 40-gallon unit or upgrading to a larger, more efficient model, Blue Jay Appliance Services handles the entire installation from start to finish. We remove your old water heater, install the new unit with proper gas or electrical connections, ensure code-compliant venting, and test everything before we leave. Our technicians are licensed for both gas and electric water heater work and familiar with local building codes throughout DuPage and Will counties.

contentSections.heading: Helping You Choose the Right Water Heater
contentSections.body: The right water heater depends on your household size, hot water demand, fuel type, and budget. We install 30-, 40-, 50-, and 75-gallon tank water heaters in both gas and electric configurations. A standard 40- or 50-gallon unit works well for most families, while larger homes with multiple bathrooms may need a 75-gallon model or dual-tank setup. We walk you through the options honestly — including brand recommendations, energy ratings, and the right capacity for your household — so you make the decision that fits your home and budget.
